/home/zume/projects/fast-juku/fast-juku-.serviceRawFile:
service: fast-juku-backend

frameworkVersion: '4'

custom:
  table_name:
    dev: second_table
    prod: main_table

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: python3.11
  stage: ${opt:stage, 'dev'}
  region: ap-northeast-3
  iam:
    role:
      statements:
          - Effect: 'Allow'
            Action:
              - 'dynamodb:*'
            Resource:
              - "arn:aws:dynamodb:ap-northeast-3:133507509735:table/*"
  ecr:
    scanOnPush: true
    # Definitions of images that later can be referenced by key in `function.image`
    images:
      fast_juku_backend:
        path: ./
        # Dockerfile that will be used when building the image locally (default: 'Dockerfile')
        platform: linux/amd64 
        file: Dockerfile
        buildArgs:
          STAGE: ${sls:stage}
  environment:
    REGION: ${self:provider.region}
    TABLE_NAME: ${self:custom.table_name.${self:provider.stage}}

functions:
  myFunction:
    image:
      name: fast_juku_backend
      command:
        - api.main.lambda_handler
    url:
      cors: true
    events:
      - http:
          path: /{proxy+}
          method: ANY
